step1_analysis.description: A positive-feedback circuit used in flash memory to accelerate bitline discharge and sense the cell state. It uses a PMOS to detect the bitline voltage drop, which triggers an NMOS to rapidly pull the bitline to ground, while providing a full-swing output.

paper_reference.title: A 126.6-mm2 AND-Type 512-Mb Flash Memory With 1.8-V Power Supply

Supply_Voltage.description: Main core supply voltage for the read operation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Directly set by the VDD source.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard nominal voltage for sky130 1.8V devices.

Trip_Voltage.description: The bitline voltage (N3) at which the positive feedback loop snaps and pulls the bitline to ground.

sky130_expected.calculation: Occurs when I_XM4 ≈ I_cell. 10uA = 0.5 * 50uA/V^2 * 10 * (1.8 - Vtrip - 0.42)^2 -> Vtrip ≈ 1.18V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the cell discharge current and PMOS threshold voltage.

Sense_Margin.description: The voltage difference between the precharged bitline and the trip point.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports a highly optimized 13mV margin for multilevel sensing, likely using a precise reference. In this basic testbench, the margin is determined by the native Vthp.

Response_Time.description: Time from the bitline starting to discharge until the output crosses 0.9V.

sky130_expected.calculation: Time to discharge from 1.4V to 1.18V at 10V/us = 0.22V / 10V/us = 22ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by bitline capacitance (1pF) and cell current (10uA).

Peak_Discharge_Current.description: Maximum current sunk by the accelerator NMOS (XM1) during the snap.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by XM1 size and the peak voltage reached at N1 during the positive feedback snap.

sky130_expected.calculation: All transistors are OFF or drawing only leakage current when N3 is precharged to 1.8V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard CMOS logic leakage in standby.

Program_Voltage.description: High voltage used for Fowler-Nordheim tunneling or hot-carrier injection during programming.

sky130_expected.reasoning: This metric applies to the charge pump and memory cell array, not the bitline sense accelerator sub-circuit.

Erase_Voltage.description: High voltage used for erasing the flash sectors.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Applies to the flash array, not this sub-circuit.

Pass_Voltage.description: Wordline pass voltage for unselected cells in the AND string.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Applies to the wordline drivers, not this sub-circuit.

Read_Voltage.description: Wordline voltage applied to the selected cell during read.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Applies to the wordline drivers, not this sub-circuit.

Charge_Pump_Efficiency.description: Efficiency of the on-chip high voltage generators.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Applies to the charge pump blocks, not this sub-circuit.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis simulating a bitline discharge by a flash cell. Measures the trip voltage, response time, peak discharge current, and static power of the accelerator.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Bitline Accelerator Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u

XM1 N3 N1 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 OUT N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 N1 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N1 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 VDD N3 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN2 N2 0 0
VN4 N4 0 0

* Bitline capacitance
CBL N3 0 1p
* Output load
ROUT OUT 0 100k
COUT OUT 0 10f

* Cell discharge current (starts at 10ns)
Icell N3 0 PWL(0 0 10n 0 11n 10u)

* Precharge to 1.8V
.ic v(N3)=1.8 v(N1)=0 v(OUT)=0

.control
tran 100p 100n
* Measure trip voltage
meas tran trip_voltage find v(N3) when v(OUT)=0.9 rise=1
* Measure response time
meas tran t_start when v(N3)=1.4 fall=1
meas tran t_out when v(OUT)=0.9 rise=1
let response_time = t_out - t_start
print response_time
* Measure peak discharge current
meas tran peak_current max i(VN2)
let peak_discharge_current = peak_current
print peak_discharge_current
* Measure static power
meas tran pwr_static find i(VVDD) at=5n
let static_power = -pwr_static * 1.8
print static_power
* Sense Margin
let sense_margin = 1.8 - trip_voltage
print sense_margin
quit
.endc
